trigger: Both first-interview survivors passed source, data, and consequence gates but failed execution readiness because their published R dependency paths were not executable in the clean local R 4.1 runtime.
process_change: Require a pre-admission runtime preflight: declared dependency availability, pinned version or reconstruction lock, and no-outcome structural rehearsal before full audit.
scope: This gate judges operational reproducibility only. It neither rewards scientific outcome nor substitutes for the seven-condition, nontriviality, first-interview, or execution-readiness gates.
negative_evidence: Sensor cv.r required unavailable hash and hydroGOF packages.
Virus correlative script required unavailable lme4 and a compatible Matrix-era dependency path.
next_permitted_action: Apply runtime preflight to every new seed and develop one explicitly versioned reconstruction before attempting another primary/reserve certification.
